name: Manuela Llerena
bio:
Manuela Llerena is an accomplished actress whose work shines across the stage, film, and television. With films slated for release in 2027, including Ocêanico, Marta, and O Zelador, her talent has been recognized in productions such as Magnífica 70 (HBO, 2015) and Malhação: Eu Só Quero Amar (Globo, 2015), where she demonstrated her ability to bring complex and emotionally layered characters to life.

On screen, Manuela has made her mark in films including E Se Ela Tivesse um Coração (2018), B.O (2019), and Vertigem (2019), showcasing her versatility across genres and her ability to captivate audiences with her magnetic presence.

On television, her talent has been featured in series such as Desnude (GNT, 2018), Jesus (Record, 2018), and Os Dias Eram Assim (Globo, 2017). Manuela also has a strong presence on stage, having appeared in theatrical productions including Mulheres de Buço (2017) and Tãotão (2016), where she has demonstrated her passion for the performing arts and her ability to forge a visceral connection with audiences.

credits.overview: The 1990s marked the success of the boy-band Chocante. Twenty years later, the group has disbanded and the members took different paths in life. The old colleagues gather for an unexpected event, the death of one of the group members.
